exposure: Programmed intermittent epidural boluses (PIEBs) with 0.1% ropivacaine/2 mg/ml fentanyl
Programmed intermittent epidural boluses (PIEBs) with 0.2% ropivacaine/2 mg/ml fentanyl
outcome: Visual Analog Scale (VAS) scores for pain
cohort: Parturients receiving epidural analgesia for labor.
finding: Both 0.1% and 0.2% ropivacaine regimens provided satisfactory labor epidural analgesia without motor blockade; however, the 0.2% group showed higher pain relief and satisfaction but also lower diastolic blood pressure, lower APGAR scores, and a lower satisfactory extrusion stage.
mod_finding: The 0.2% ropivacaine group was associated with a lower satisfactory extrusion stage observed by the obstetrician.
